description:
Activate Loporrit Scout by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping the basic land.
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
